description: This file is a TypeScript configuration or utility file for setting up testing environments related to the Feishu extension in a project. It imports functions and variables from other modules, defines helper functions to load environment-specific test patterns, and creates a Vitest configuration object for the Feishu extension, which is then exported as the default.

methods.name: export function loadIncludePatternsFromEnv( loadIncludePatternsFromEnv
methods.description: Loads a list of include patterns for tests from environment variables or defaults.

methods.name: export function createExtensionFeishuVitestConfig( createExtensionFeishuVitestConfig
methods.description: Creates a Vitest configuration for Feishu extension tests, merging environment patterns with defaults.
